_readme: Past projects. Each entry = one job. Photos live in images/projects/<slug>/, floor plans / layout drawings (optional) in images/projects/<slug>/plans/. Entries with "sample": true are SAMPLE placeholders (illustrative plans and images, not real clients). Delete them once real jobs are added. See UPDATING.md.

projects.title: SAMPLE: Kosher Kitchen & Dining Re-Layout
projects.summary: A placeholder showing how a kitchen layout project will appear.
projects.description: SAMPLE ENTRY, not a real client. Images and the plan sketch are placeholders. A real project would explain the layout problem and the solution, for example how the kitchen was re-planned into separate meat and dairy work zones with their own sinks and counters, and how the wall to the dining room moved so the table could extend for Yom Tov with a clear walkway behind the chairs.

projects.title: SAMPLE: Ground Floor & Sukkah Deck Plan

projects.description: SAMPLE ENTRY, not a real client. The photos and the floor plan are illustrative examples. A project like this would explain the planning decisions: a sukkah deck placed right off the kitchen, a dining room sized for a table that seats 14 and extends to 20, a Pesach pantry next to the dining room, and a study with a full seforim wall.
